description: Rabbit’s whole catalog: 1688 products already screened (checked photo, recorded price, brand-free name), with the price of one piece in the client’s currency. Filter it to their needs: category, budget per piece, minimum order, new models from verified manufacturers, beginner-friendly products, words. The answer gives the total, the pages and the categories that exist: page through for more. Rabbit gives no resale price and no profit. Free, no quota.

debutant.description: true: only beginner-friendly products (sold by the piece, no fashion or beauty).

minimum_max.description: The highest minimum order they accept, in pieces, optional.

mots.description: Words from the product name (“cat”, “bottle”), optional.

nouveautes.description: true: only new models from manufacturers verified on 1688.

par_page.description: How many products per page (20 if omitted, 50 at most).

prix_max.description: Their budget per piece, in their account’s currency, optional.

tri.description: The order: most ordered first (if omitted), or by price.
